Author: Stwohm (fork of yagi2/Restocker)
Name: Restocky
Punchline: Restocker fork: bulk reprice with price guards, history log and an optional bell auto-cycle.
Description: Personal fork of yagi2/Restocker. Cross-retainer market workbench: reprice every listing to the live market lowest -N gil, bulk-list inventory with stack splitting. Fork additions: fixes for the duplicate-listing queue crash and stale-snapshot row mismatch, price guards (per-item floor, max drop %, outlier skip), a persistent price-history.csv, a one-click full cycle and an optional timed auto-cycle while at the summoning bell.
Changelog: 0.3.5.3 — An empty right-click menu while fetching prices is retried (2x) and the row skipped instead of stopping the run; I set prices only fills prices fetched during this visit. 0.3.5.2 — Sale history is requested on every retainer visit (also I set prices + Apply, fetch, restock, refresh); delayed AllaganMarket notices (up to 72 h) and identical stacks now match the history sale; existing duplicate sales are merged automatically at load. 0.3.5.1 — Fix: sale history records were dropped before the retainer was known (now captured also when another plugin opens the history window; diagnostic log lines prefixed '[Restocky] history:'); Fix: market board results from other worlds (world visit) no longer reach the price cache or the (!) tooltip; Update prices table is sortable (default: by item name, so stacks of the same item sit together). 0.3.5.0 — Sales are read from each retainer's sale history during cycles (buyer, time, exact proceeds; toggle in settings); (!) icon in Update prices lists cheaper listings with per-rival 24h/3d/1w undercut counts and the most active rivals; automatic cost basis from market board purchases (FIFO), Profit column and Costs tab; realized profit, Stuck listings and sales Velocity in the Sales tab; suggested low-stock threshold. 0.3.4.0 — Sales are recorded from AllaganMarket's sale message (also fixes listings closed as "gone" within 72 h); Hold checkbox in Update prices: automatic cycles never change a held item's price. 0.3.3.0 — Refresh all updates Low stock counts at once; low stock shown in the tab title and window header; price lines after every run; List & price opens the game sale window and waits for your price. 0.3.2.0 — Per-item price change lines in chat after each cycle; Low stock tab with alerts, market price suggestion (lowest -undercut, Use / Check) , one-click Restock (prefers the retainer that already sells the item), and List & price when nothing is listed (game price window, rest follows). 0.3.1.0 — Auto-advance retainer Talk dialogues, Full cycle (I set prices) button, scrollable plan lists, your price / market lowest beside floors, bait-listing notices, configurable chat channel (default Retainer Sale). 0.3.0.0 — Listing lifecycle and competitor tracking, AutoRetainer coordination, materia name fix, editable interval.
